> 🔀 Delegated to the **platform** agent

I've started this as task `t_00474f78`. The answer will post into this thread as soon as it's ready.

Task `t_00474f78` has finished with status **done**.

**Status:** done · platform · Investigate and remediate checkout service failures in gitops-pilot-20260917-141050 · `t_00474f78`

**Complete Result:**

## What's wrong
`Deployment/checkout` in namespace `payments` fails to scale to desired replica count (4 replicas) due to admission rejection against `ResourceQuota/payments-quota`.

## Why
- `Deployment/checkout` container `web` requested `256Mi` memory per replica (`4 x 256Mi = 1024Mi`).
- `Deployment/pricer` in the same namespace requests `2 x 64Mi = 128Mi` memory.
- Total memory requested across `payments` namespace was `1152Mi`, exceeding `ResourceQuota/payments-quota` hard limit of `832Mi` (`requests.memory`).
- Kubernetes admission rejected the 4th replica of `checkout` with `FailedCreate` (`exceeded quota: payments-quota`).

## What to do
- Merge Pull Request [PR #40](https://github.com/gke-agentic/fuxiao-gkedemo-infra/pull/40) on branch `run/gitops-pilot-20260917-141050/b-0011`.
- The PR reverts `Deployment/checkout` memory request from `256Mi` to `64Mi` in `tasks/b-0011/10-workloads.yaml`, bringing total namespace request to `384Mi` (`4 x 64Mi + 2 x 64Mi`), well within `832Mi` quota and restoring replica count to 4/4.
